name: Species
description: Species traits. Riders sit just below the attacks they ride until Phase 2 draws them on the attack itself.

entries.name: Fire’s Burn (Fire Giant)
entries.note: Extra fire on a hit with any attack roll. On screen, just under the attacks it rides.

entries.name: Frost’s Chill (Frost Giant)
entries.note: Extra cold and a slow on a hit. Name keyed by pattern; not yet seen picked on a real sheet.

entries.name: Hill’s Tumble (Hill Giant)
entries.note: Knocks a Large-or-smaller target prone on a hit. Name keyed by pattern; not yet seen picked on a real sheet.
